html:
The Nukunu are an Aboriginal Australian people of South Australia, whose country runs along the upper Spencer Gulf and into the southern Flinders Ranges.

Their neighbours were the Barngarla across the gulf, the Ngadjuri to the east, the Kaurna to the south and the Adnyamathanha of the northern ranges.

After the founding of South Australia, sheep runs took their land in the 1840s. The towns of Port Pirie and Port Augusta grew up on Nukunu country, Port Pirie later becoming a great lead smelting town.
sum: The Nukunu are an Aboriginal Australian people of South Australia, whose country runs along the upper Spencer Gulf and into the southern Flinders Ranges.
